action.command: cd /workspace && nohup yarn dev > /tmp/dev3.log 2>&1 & echo "pid $!"; sleep 18; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/root.html -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 90 "http://localhost:3000/"); echo "root -> $code ($(wc -c </tmp/root.html) bytes)"; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/root.html | head; grep -oiE 'klimadashboard|münster' /tmp/root.html | sort | uniq -c | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup yarn dev > /tmp/dev3.log 2>&1 & echo \"pid $!\"; sleep 18; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/root.html -w \"%{http_code}\" --max-time 90 \"http://localhost:3000/\"); echo \"root -> $code ($(wc -c </tmp/root.html) bytes)\"; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/root.html | head; grep -oiE 'klimadashboard|m\u00fcnster' /tmp/root.html | sort | uniq -c | head", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Clean restart and capture root"}
